scope: Atomic fenced job cancellation persistence primitive and SQLite wrapper lifetime repair

residual_risks.detail: Gc.keep_alive guards Sqlite3.finalize and Sqlite3.db_close where crashes occurred, but is not a full audit of all runtime-releasing C stubs in sqlite3-ocaml 5.4.1 (e.g., step, exec, prepare) if handles are not otherwise stack-rooted by callers.

cancel_job_once is a store-level primitive trusting caller-supplied now_ns and control-plane fields; reviewer cryptographic receipt authentication, clock synchronization, and Telegram routing remain unimplemented future Gleam work.

Cancellation clears only the SQLite job lease (job_lease_cleared=true, task_cancelled=false, process_quiesced=false); worker process termination and post-expiry reconciliation require separate supervision and authorized read paths.
Replay checks execute after bridge/task lease validation and before expires_at_ns; retries after lease or request expiry fail closed and require a separate read query to inspect prior receipts.

next: Authenticated exact-intent approvals and trusted Gleam adapter, then observed controlled-action outcomes and Telegram routing
